name: Kajiki (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kajiki town emblem in white: a ring with a winged top crossed by a diagonal stroke.
history: Flag of the former town of Kajiki in Kagoshima Prefecture, dissolved on 2010-03-23. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 August 1968.

features.role: Kajiki town emblem — a ring with a winged top crossed by a diagonal stroke
